plain_statement: Points and lines, no two points on two common lines, inputs the points then the lines. Every least circuit of AND/OR gates, each reading exactly two wires (it reads only earlier wires), true exactly when some incident point and line are both on, that is top-stuck (a wire below the function that an OR gate reads is read only by top-tree ORs: ORs tied to the output by single-reader ORs) is two-level: every AND reads a point-side OR and a line-side OR.
title: 4-cycle-free bipartite incidence: every least exact fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for it that is top-stuck is two-level
